**Implements:** [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GifResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/GifResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format of GIF files, played as animated images.

## Description

A GIF of one frame plays as an animation of one frame.

<a id="GifResourceFormat-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(byte[] header)` 

If `true`, `header` starts with `GIF87a` or `GIF89a`.

<a id="GifResourceFormat-method-decoder"></a>

### decoder

`IResourceDecoder decoder(Asset asset, byte[] header)` 

Returns an [`AnimatedResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/animatedresourcedecoder/) that reads the GIF.
